result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both pages set body text at a comfortable size in a single constrained column with system fonts, and each puts more space above section headings than below them. A's line spacing is more open (about 1.7) at roughly 20px, which suits a long read better. B is solid but slightly denser, and its pull quote wraps awkwardly early, after only a few words. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both use a centered serif column with good size, measure and heading spacing. B has slightly larger body text, more open line spacing (about 1.8), a comfortable measure of about 60 characters, and a pull quote that sits cleanly on one line. A is solid, but its pull quote wraps awkwardly in a narrow box and its masthead doesn't line up with the text column. B's dark theme is a style choice the rubric doesn't penalize.
